reason: Conversation 1 immediately identified the door balance spring/cable system, asked the sensible first question (check both sides for a broken or slack spring), confirmed the right-hand spring was hanging loose, sought the full model number, and gave a correct diagnosis with a power-off instruction and an engineer fallback; its only weaknesses were recommending a full hinge assembly rather than a spring/cable kit, not mentioning replacing springs in pairs, and vague access advice given the unit is screwed in. Conversation 2 ignored the clearly mechanical symptom and ran an irrelevant 'won't start' script (power, door sensor, child lock, latch, delay start) despite the customer repeatedly describing a dropping door, a twang, and a visibly hanging spring, then concluded with a flatly wrong 'start control' diagnosis and an unjustified engineer referral, never addressing the actual fault at all.
